product: Advertising across Facebook Instagram and WhatsApp. Q2 2026 advertising revenue was 59.36B usd of 60.80B usd total (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). Management guided FY2026 capex of 130-145B usd and operating income above 2025 (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
bull: Q2 2026 revenue 60.8B up 28 pct, ad impressions +14 pct, price per ad +12 pct (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29); Muse shipped 2026-09-08 and Meta One 2026-09-15; eight dated PT raises 2026-09-22/25.
bear: Operating margin fell to 31 pct from 43 pct, costs +55 pct, FCF only 784M on 31.08B capex, EPS 6.18 missed 7.19, 2.4B legal charges (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29; MarketBeat 2026-09-25).
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-28: revenue below the 61B usd guidance floor, or FY2026 capex above 145B usd, or free cash flow still near zero (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30d: Muse personal AI agent launched 2026-09-08 (about.fb.com); Meta One subscriptions 2026-09-15; Connect 2026-09-23/24 added Muse on AI glasses, 100g Meta VR Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio; stock up about 12 pct 2026-09-21 (Seeking Alpha). web_true_now_not_modelled: Muse and Meta One monetization just began, no revenue disclosed (about.fb.com 2026-09-08/15). EPS 6.18 missed 7.19 consensus (MarketBeat 2026-09-25). 2.4B usd legal charges plus New Mexico jury loss 2026-09-25 (Reuters) may be under-modelled.
web_demand_product: Advertising across Facebook Instagram and WhatsApp. Q2 2026 advertising revenue was 59.36B usd of 60.80B usd total (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). Emerging demand drivers are the Muse personal AI agent and Meta One subscriptions (about.fb.com 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-15), plus AI glasses and Reality Labs hardware at 431M usd.
web_price_volume_mix: Both, with volume leading. Q2 2026 ad impressions rose 14 pct YoY while average price per ad rose 12 pct YoY; Family daily active people were 3.60B up 3 pct (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). Growth is volume-driven AI ranking plus firm pricing.
web_bottleneck: Compute and capex. FY2026 capex is guided 130-145B usd; Q2 capex 31.08B usd; free cash flow only 784M usd (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). Meta also relieves a consumer bottleneck of time and coordination via Muse (about.fb.com 2026-09-08).
web_who_benefits_next: Suppliers and partners. Corning via the Petal subsea cable (Yahoo 2026-09-22); commerce and payment partners Shopify Stripe Link PayPal Walmart and Best Buy (about.fb.com 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-22); AI compute and chip vendors absorbing the 130-145B usd capex (SEC 2026-07-29).
web_who_loses: Rival AI assistants and platforms: Google and OpenAI style agents, Amazon retail search and advertising, and Apple and Google app stores as Muse handles shopping checkout and agent tasks (Reuters 2026-09-22; Yahoo 2026-09-24). Meta was itself blocked from AI shopping access (Yahoo 2026-09-24).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Costs outrunning revenue. Q2 2026 operating margin fell to 31 pct from 43 pct, total costs rose 55 pct and R and D was 21.66B usd (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). There were 2.4B usd legal charges, and youth-related trials may result in material loss (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
web_low_cost_substitute: not found. I read no primary or wire source quantifying a Chinese or other low-cost substitute for Muse or for Meta advertising; no sourced evidence was read on this point.
web_ceo_promised: 2026-07-29 Zuckerberg said AI is accelerating our core business today, powering our next generation of products, and opening the door to entirely new enterprise opportunities (SEC 8-K). Management guided FY2026 capex of 130-145B usd and operating income above 2025 (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
web_did_they_deliver: Partly. Q2 2026 revenue rose 28 pct and ad price 12 pct, showing AI ad gains, but operating income fell 8 pct and EPS 6.18 missed the 7.19 consensus (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29; MarketBeat 2026-09-25). Muse shipped 2026-09-08 as promised (about.fb.com).
web_what_would_falsify: Q3 2026 results, estimated 2026-10-28 (MarketBeat): revenue below the 61B usd guidance floor, FY2026 capex above 145B usd, or free cash flow staying near zero would break the thesis; a material youth-litigation loss also qualifies (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
